race.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: NOLTON CROSS is fancied to make a big impact returning to a C&D where he's won twice before and with a handy mark to work with, he can prove too strong for John T , who ran well when second here 26 days ago and is building a good all-weather profile. Oneforthegutter is well treated and will be staying on strongly if they go hard enough for him. NOLTON CROSS (IRE) JOHN T ONEFORTHEGUTTER
race.bettingForecast: Optician (5/2), Oneforthegutter (5/1), Lady Magu (11/2), John T (6/1), Joseph (6/1), Nolton Cross (8/1), Prince Of Calypso (12/1), Naval Command (14/1), Without Compromise (20/1)
